text: BUTZAW, a town of Lower Saxony, in Germany; it floods upon the river Varnow, on the road from Sehaven to Rolloek.

parsed.faithful: BUTZAW, a town of Lower Saxony, in Germany; it flands upon the river Varnow, on the road from Schwerin to Rostock.
parsed.modern: BUTZAW, a town of Lower Saxony, in Germany; it stands upon the river Varnow, on the road from Schwerin to Rostock.
